news.title: Brasil e Filipinas assinam acordos sobre agro e livre concorrência
news.summary: Brasil e Filipinas assinaram, neste sábado (14), em Manila, dois acordos para facilitar o comércio agrícola e fortalecer o combate a práticas anticoncorrenciais entre os dois países. Os dois memorandos de entendimento foram firmados durante a visita oficial do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva ao país asiático, após reunião com o presidente filipino, Ferdinand Marcos Júnior. Notícias relacionadas: Lula cita herói anticolonial das Filipinas ao comentar sua reeleição. Lula chega às Filipinas; Brasil quer ser Parceiro de Diálogo da Asean. Nos últimos anos, Brasil e Filipinas vêm aprofundando a agenda de cooperação bilateral. Em 2026, foi anunciada a assistência técnica para o fortalecimento da indústria canavieira filipina. Os dois países também buscam estabelecer novas parcerias em pesquisas agropecuárias. Os negócios entre Brasil e Filipinas movimentam, atualmente, cerca de US$ 3 bilhões. Asean O presidente Lula viajou para as Filipinas a fim de participar, a convite de Ferdinand Marcos Júnior, da Cúpula da Associação de Nações do Sudeste Asiático (Asean). O mandatário brasileiro também participa do Fórum Empresarial Brasil-Filipinas, no qual serão abordados temas relacionados ao comércio bilateral e a parcerias internacionais. Memorandos de entendimento Segundo o Gabinete de Segurança Institucional (GSI) da Presidência da República, um memorando de entendimento é um instrumento jurídico prévio, de cunho político, para alinhar objetivos e definir os termos iniciais de uma negociação.

news.title: Inside Ethiopia's war: Rare access to a hospital treating victims of renewed fighting
news.summary: Ethiopia's renewed conflict is taking an increasing toll on civilians, with humanitarian organisations reporting a rise in casualties. In the Amhara region, FRANCE 24’s correspondent Tom Canetti was granted rare access to a civilian hospital where surgeons are struggling to treat the influx of wounded patients. But for many caught in the fighting, reaching medical care is a challenge in itself. Warning: The report contains images of surgery that may be confronting for some viewers.

news.title: Produzir aço “verde” no Brasil compensa mais que exportar hidrogênio
news.summary: Análise apresentada na FAPESP Week Países Baixos mostra que produzir aço no Ceará reduz emissões e custos industriais; a siderurgia "verde" cria empregos de maior qualificação no Nordeste, segundo pesquisadora

news.title: Who are the 'street medics' showing up at protests around the world?
news.summary: From treating tear gas exposure to tending to injuries, street medics have become an increasingly common sight at protests all over the world. But who exactly are they and when did they start showing up at demonstrations? Story by Daniel Quinlan.

news.title: U2 releases first new studio album in a decade, 'Caranaval de Luz'
news.summary: U2 just released a new album after nine years of no new content. And fans are already rocking out to the new songs. Details on the Irish rock band’s comeback by Ophelie Jacobson.

news.summary: A nuclear treaty and the US's war on Iran are among priority topics for China, Russia and US leaders.

news.summary: Em entrevista à BBC News Brasil, professor aponta limites da vitória de Lula e de conquistas recentes da esquerda no Brasil e no mundo.

news.summary: The US has broached the idea of Kyiv giving up the Donbas region in exchange for NATO membership, the Ukrainian president said.

news.title: Dos palestinos muertos en Gaza en un bombardeo israelí a pesar del alto el fuego
news.summary: Al menos dos personas han muerto y varias más han resultado heridas después de un nuevo bombardeo de un dron israelí perpetrado este sábado en Yabalia, en el norte de la Franja de Gaza, a pesar del alto el fuego formalmente en vigor desde hace más de un año.

news.title: New facilities in Laos and Cambodia: Is China expanding its military presence in Southeast Asia?
news.summary: China has been growing its economic relationships in Southeast Asia. Now new military facilities in Laos and Cambodia are causing smaller countries to worry China's military networks are also expanding.

news.title: Após horas de blecaute global, Microsoft diz que serviços foram totalmente normalizados
news.summary: Falha afetou governos e empresas em mais de 70 países, atingindo programa de e-mail Outlook e aplicativo de mensagens Teams. Especialistas alertam para dependência excessiva de tecnologia de uma única empresa.

news.title: Half a million people gather for an open-air mass by Pope Leo in Peru
news.summary: Pope Leo said it was a "joy to be back" in his second home of Chiclayo, where he made his name as a bishop. This is the latest stop on his South America tour, the very tour that saw fears of cancellation after the Pope underwent surgery for lung cancer. Story by Vedika Bahl.

news.title: Eight sentenced to jail over Nurmagomedov-Dvalishvili Abu Dhabi hotel brawl
news.summary: A brawl broke out between the two MMA fighters and their teams inside a hotel before a wrestling event.

news.title: Microsoft's widespread outages caused global chaos, including in the healthcasre industry
news.summary: Microsoft says it is seeing improvements in its service availability after an hours-long disruption knocked out its platforms including Outlook and Teams. The outage has affected hundreds of millions of people across the globe. The healthcare industry was among those impacted, as Ophelie Jacobson explains.

news.title: Ukraine, Russia race to build military satellite networks as war rages on
news.summary: Kyiv seeks to break reliance on Starlink as Moscow develops its own satellite constellation for military communications.

news.title: France fend off South African comeback to clinch long-awaited win in Paris
news.summary: Twenty-one years after last beating the Springboks in Paris, Les Bleus held out for a 21-19 win over the world champions on Friday after a nailbiting finale. Antoine Dupont and company are now one step away from reaching the Nations Championship final in London.

news.title: Hungarian authorities uncover $20m during probe of Orbán-era minister
news.summary: Prime Minister Péter Magyar promised a sweeping anti-corruption drive after ousting Orbán in April.

news.title: Rusia anuncia la toma de otra localidad en la región ucraniana de Zaporiyia
news.summary: El Ministerio de Defensa de Rusia ha anunciado este sábado que sus fuerzas militares han tomado el control de la localidad de Tersianka, en la región ucraniana de Zaporiyia, tras una operación encabezada por unidades del Ejército ruso desplegadas en los frentes del este y sur de Ucrania.

news.title: South Sudan postpones first-ever national elections until February
news.summary: The vote, first expected in 2022, will now be held on February 11, according to the country's election commission.

news.title: US proposed Ukraine cedes Donbas in exchange for joining NATO, Zelensky says
news.summary: President Zelensky said the US had proposed ceding Ukraine's eastern city of Donbas to Russia, in exchange for Ukrainian membership of NATO, following the latest round of peace talks in Abu Dhabi this week. He reiterated that Kyiv was not willing to retreat from its territory and warned that the Kremlin's bid to change the continent's security architecture could lead to more wars.

news.title: 'Climate action is alive': Triumphant Democrats attend COP31 summit shunned by Trump
news.summary: A delegation of 18 Democratic lawmakers arrived at the COP31 climate summit in Turkey on Saturday to reaffirm the US commitment to tackling global warming following their sweeping midterm election victory.

news.title: SpaceX's Starship encounters problems during 15th test flight
news.summary: Elon Musk’s SpaceX successfully launched its Starship, the world's largest spaceship, into orbit where it should release 15 satellites for its Starlink network. A few minutes after lift off however, the rocket's booster which was meant to return to the pad splashed down in the Gulf of Mexico. Details by Daniel Quinlan.

news.title: Can Nvidia survive without tech titan Jensen Huang?
news.summary: The Financial Times says computing giant Nvidia has approached Rene Haas, CEO of British chip designer Arm, in its search for a potential successor to Jensen Huang. Huang resigned after his affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Meanwhile some employees are clamouring for Huang's return – as his fellow tech leader Elon Musk. A sign of Huang's lingering star power, in an industry where so often the fate of each giant company depends on one man. Story by Peter O'Brien.

news.title: France's school principals say threats and violence have become unbearable
news.summary: Headteachers gathered across France this Friday, to demonstrate their frustration after nearly two months of student protests that have blockaded high schools. Many of the teachers support the students, but say they feel exhausted and isolated as the violence has surged. They are calling the government to protect them. Story by Vedika Bahl.

news.title: France protests for fifth Saturday against living costs and heavy-handed policing
news.summary: Different causes are set to come together for one march in Paris this Saturday. Campaign groups, students and Yellow Vest protesters are due to join forces in the capital, bringing together demands on wages, education and civil liberties. But after weeks of demonstrations, union leaders warn that protest fatigue is setting in, while police officers are seeking better compensation for the risk of policing the protests. Story by Jack Pownall.

news.title: US nationwide flight ground stop: "Our routers got overloaded with data"
news.summary: On Friday, the Federal Aviation Administration issued a rare nationwide ground stop. More than 8,200 flights, or over 31% of those scheduled in the United States, were canceled. The ground stop lasted nearly five hours and was the longest in the country since September 11, 2001. Officials blamed outdated air traffic communications equipment, and said that there was no evidence of a cyber attack. The airspace is now reopened and flights have resumed.

news.title: Sabalenka crashes out of season-ending WTA Finals after losing to Svitolina
news.summary: World number two Sabalenka's season came to a disappointing end after she failed to reach the WTA Finals semifinals.
